displayName: Data Alerts - Datastream CDC lag over 1 hour

conditions.displayName: Source-to-read lag exceeds 1 hour for 10 minutes

documentation.content:
CDC source-to-read lag has exceeded 1 hour for 10 minutes for ${resource.label.stream_id}. Investigate source replication lag, stream throughput and connectivity before required source logs expire.

This measures source-to-read delay, not the BigQuery dataFreshness setting. It can fire during backfill. Missing metrics are not proof of recovery; this policy does not detect an inactive stream with no metrics.

https://console.cloud.google.com/datastream/streams?project=fxr-analytics
